controls.duplicate_key_semantics: Python json last value wins, including equivalent escaped keys.
controls.root_scope: Object-root artifacts only. Reserved# strings/keys rejected for compressed artifacts, malformed leading-zero arrays remain rejected.

loading.scope: Complete JSON value preserved, tuple/list JSON equivalence; Python json duplicate-key last-wins semantics unchanged. No original field/census/event omitted.
